decisions.reason: The quantified customer savings and strong fit with our strategic push in modular environmental technology make this product worth continuing.
A dedicated product page suggests active market positioning, and a mobile slow-speed shredder fits closely with our core recycling equipment portfolio.
Even with limited public evidence so far, the concept builds on our established modular offering and is too close to our growth strategy to exit after only one year.
A mobile trommel screen is a natural adjacent product for our customer base and supports our broader system-selling approach in a growing market.
